R4.label: R2 sem redução robusta de peso

ratings: uniform: no historical snapshots of ratings; current ratings would use later information
first_round_undecided: exclude identified values below 3%; never infer from residual; missing information retained and counted
quality: reject negative category shares for every model; retain original records and audit log
probability_target: candidate A ahead of candidate B (the two eventual finalists), not qualification or unconditional presidential victory
uncertainty: nominal Gaussian intervals of the finalist margin; institute-cluster sampling approximation plus between-poll dispersion; common election error estimated only from prior cycles, with no candidate bias correction
primary_scoring: two finalists on full valid-vote denominator; equal election-round weight
secondary_scoring: all shared categories including Others, and held-out chronological intervals
promotion_rule: Do not replace production based only on 2026 or a better pooled average; require gain against simple baselines across cycles and no important regression. Prospective confirmation remains future work.
forbidden: No candidate-specific bonus; no simulated polls; no outcome in point estimation; no optimization of parameters against 2026. Sensitivities are reported, not selected.
